Light mode · gradientsOn the branchSave as · V10c, before it is built

Light mode’s gradients, five ways beside today’s. Each is the home screen in all five modes, drawn by the app’s code with only the gradient swapped (and the greys made neutral, as part five proposed). What carries over from the advice: blend in OKLCH, not RGB, so there is no grey dead zone; add midpoints along the hue path; keep lightness level so the band has an even weight; fade into the background rather than into a colour. What does not: grain and banding — a terminal cell holds one colour and a gradient here is about seventy cells wide, so every cell already gets its own step and there is nothing to band; noise would read as stray glyph colours.
